[[Walden]] is a [[collector]] located in [[Lakeside County]]. He can be found standing outside a house on the south-western edge of [[Ashford Village]].

==Trivia==
*[[w:Walden|''Walden'']] is the name of a book by Henry David Thoreau, in which Thoreau goes to live by a lake, called Lake Walden, as a hermit. This character seems to live the same sort of simple life and may be modeled on the title of the book.
